clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Requirements for saturated bitumen felts (underlay) and self-finished bitumen felts used for water proofing and damp-proofing.

clauses.title: Fibre Base
clauses.text: 2.1 Fibre Base Type 1 — Saturated felt for underlay Type 2 — Self finished felt  ( for water-proofing)

clauses.title: Hessian Base
clauses.text: 2.2 Hessian Base Type 3— [Self-finished felt (for water-proofing) Grade 1] [Self-finished felt (for damp-proofing) Grade 2]

clauses.title: Weight
clauses.text: 3. Weight — Weight of ingredients of bitumen felt for 10 m  shall not be less than those specified in Table1.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 4. Dimensions — It shall be in width of 90 cm or 100 cm and generally on lengths of 10 m  0r 20 m

clauses.title: The finished material shall
clauses.text: 5.1 The finished material shall be free from visible external defects, such as holes, oil patches, ragged or untrue edges, breaks, cracks, tears, protuberances and indentations.
